propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as positional body argument, stores the flag string literally, discards intended content, and exits 0 without error
a defenseless positional-body parameter that begins with - is silently coerced to the flag token itself instead of being rejected with usage guidance
surplus positional arguments holding the intended value are discarded by args[:min_args] slicing, compounding the data loss and preventing recovery
the command exits 0 and produces a comment record despite content loss, masking the failure from basic confirmation checks (len(comments) passes)
the same footgun pattern exists across multiple positional-body commands (create, edit, session-log, comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) and requires a unified guard
legitimate body values beginning with - can be supplied using -- escape syntax (e.g. rebar comment <id> -- "-starts with dash")
